_about: The blocker example from the post. The customer must cancel nut snacks because their child has an allergy, and the order ships in 12 minutes. The replies of candidates A and B, with the trace of what each system actually did.
customer: Please cancel the nut snack mix from my order, my son has a nut allergy and I ordered it by mistake. It says it ships soon!

warm.text: I'm so sorry to hear about your son's allergy, that must be really stressful! Your family's safety is our top priority and our team is always here for you. I've made a note of your concern. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

plain.text: Understood, this is urgent because of the allergy. I found order ORD-48213: it ships in 12 minutes. Removing the item timed out on my side, so I've passed it to a colleague as urgent. Update: the nut snack mix has been removed. Your order now contains oat cookies and apple juice.

trace.context: allergy, remove nut snack mix, ships in 12 min
